title: Specimen-label cohorts and culture estimates in code-defined bone and joint infection: a MIMIC-IV measurement study (analysis code)
description:
Analysis code reproducing every number, table and figure in the manuscript “Specimen-label cohorts and culture estimates in code-defined bone and joint infection: a MIMIC-IV measurement study”.

The study measures how far culture-based estimates in code-defined orthopaedic infection depend on which specimen labels are analysed. Specimen labels are split into a source-specific tier (joint fluid, prosthetic joint fluid, explicit sonication) and a generic tier (tissue, biopsy, undifferentiated foreign body). No growth requires a laboratory-reported completed routine bacterial culture. First-isolate flags are scoped within each tier. The primary comparison is made within episodes that contributed both tiers, using patient-clustered inference and an episode-stratified conditional logistic model.

MIMIC-IV is credentialed and is not redistributed here. No patient-level data are included. See DATA_ACCESS.md for how to obtain the source database from PhysioNet.

Run python run_all.py to reproduce all outputs; code/99_audit.py asserts every quantity reported in the manuscript against the generated digests and exits non-zero on any mismatch.
